statement: No patch notes on Discord or Steam; only in-game notes exist and reportedly omit some changes including shadow nerfs/changes.
World 7 tasks unlocked via Wavy Wayne in top left of W7 town; four tasks repeatable up to 10 times each plus five merit shop upgrades.
New early sushi upgrade combo meter near top of upgrade list; must buy it first.
Rack up combo hits by combining sushi using only sushi on the board; cooking new sushi breaks the combo.
Added advanced option to hide item pickup status to help game performance.
Added auto play to the event game using the same solo strategy used to simulate odds.
Pet tokens spent on tournament champion pets are now refunded forever like Glongko Supreme.
Made end-game visual adjustments for Spelunking to help game performance.
Amber re-supply swap changed from 25x amber and 20x less drops to 15x amber and 10x less drops; developer will keep adjusting until strictly beneficial.
Creator suspects the change did not make the upgrade strictly beneficial and may have nerfed his world record setup.
Fixed bug where new emotion system giving statue EXP from creating Xeno clusters sometimes made emotion gains disappear.
Fixed third outpost upgrade Greater Education so boost rank EXP gain gives full bonus.
Fixed research K5 upgrade text to specify it only affects OG master classes; wording garbled.
Fixed graphical error where Bubba mega flash was too low and overlapped Bubba's speech bubble.
Fixed issue where pig plus took teleports away.
Many bugs remain unfixed; creator most cares about RG and Peter Pages issue which hasn't changed.
Players report resource changes in Royal Guardian; tremendous traders upgrade now gives extra experience per trader unit.
Trader profession unlock appears moved earlier and cheaper; each trader unit gives extra outpost trading rank experience.
Cost reduction matters since only one upgrade can be bought with leaves.
Wavy Wayne quest requires gathering 100 each of W7 drops such as flesh and tail items to unlock tasks.
Merit shop has spelunking power as a multiplier upgrade.
Merit shop upgrades: max stamina for all characters in spelunking; Minehead currency gain multiplier; faster Shimmerfin Deep mob respawn; five research points; recipe unlock.
Task: total best depth of 50 across all tunnels including manic mode; another task wants total of 100k across all tunnels.
Task: reach total knowledge level of 100 across all sushi.
Task: use 100 or more stamina in a single spelunking run.
Task: deal 5k damage in a single round of Minehead charge; easy.
Tasks include defeating the world seven boss and completing five Shimmerfin achievements which are not yet available.
Task board exists but achievements and daily tasks do not yet.
Spelunking power merit upgrade gives 15 per level as a multiplier.
Spelunking power is a true multiplier and really good; stamina merit gives 20 stamina to all characters.
Minehead currency gain gives 10% per level so maxing gives 100% extra.
Research points and respawn merit upgrades give one per level.
Creator expects to get lots of merit points from Minehead and stamina tasks.
Combining sushi adds score equal to tier created to the combo meter; cooking new sushi or taking too long ends it; permanent box multiplier based on best combo.
Combo ends on timeout
confidence: and gives a multiplier; presetting the board might help.

statement: Expects a single meta strategy to emerge for combo meter.
Getting to a thousand combo gives 9x; higher combo gives more.
Combo meter may not get him to interact with sushi more but would be fun for 10 minutes.
